senses.gloss:
f. (-क्षा)
1 Wish, desire.
2 The wish to speak.
E.
वच to speak, in the desiderative form, aff. अच्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Wished, desired.
2 Purposed, intended.
3 Literal, not figurative, (a word or phrase.)
4 Intended to be spoken or said.
n. (-तं)
An object desired.
f. (-ता)
Purpose, wish, what one wishes to declare or speak.
E.
वच to speak, desiderative form, क्त aff.

mfn. (-क्षुः-क्षुः-क्षु)
Wishing to speak.
E.
वच to speak, desid. v., उ aff.

mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु)
Crafty, deceitful.
E.
वि before वञ्च to trick, desid. v., उ aff.

f. (-त्सा)
A cow whose calf is dead.
E.
वि priv., वत्स a calf.

mfn. (-दन्-दन्ती-दत्)
1 Disputing, contending.
2 Litigating.
E.
वि variously, वद to speak, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Disagreeing, contending, maintaining different arguments.
2 Litigating.
E.
वि before वद to speak, शानच् aff.

m. (-धः)
1 A road, a highway.
2 A yoke for carrying burdens.
3 A load.
4 Storing grain or hay, &c.
5 An ewer, a pitcher.
E.
वि before वध to strike, aff. घञ्; also वीवध.

m. (-धः)
1 A yoke for carrying burthens.
2 A burthen.
2 Storing or heaping corn.
4 A road: see विवध.

m. (-कः)
A chandler.
E.
विवध storing grain, ठन् aff., and the vowel unchanged; also वैवधिक.

mfn. (-कः-की)
1 A chandler.
2 A man or woman carrying a load by means of a yoke.
E.
वीवध as above, ठन् aff., and the first vowel unchanged.

mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु)
Desirous or wishing to praise.
E.
वदि to praise, desid. v., उ aff.

n. (-रं)
1 A hole, a chasm, a vacuity.
2 Fault, defect.
3 Separation, disjunction.
E.
वि before वृञ् to choose, to cover, &c., and अच् aff.

m. (-रः)
1 Dilatation, expansion.
2 Open or expanded state of the organs of speech for the articulation of vowels and sibilants.
E.
वि before वृ to cover, घञ् aff.

n. (-णं)
1 Explanation, exposition, gloss, comment.
2 Interpretation, translation.
3 Uncovering, exposing, laying bare or open.
4 Detailing, describing.
E.
वि before वृ to select (the meaning), aff. ल्युट्.

f. (-का)
A pipe, a fife, a flute.
E.
विवर a hole, a perforation, नाल a pipe, कन् added, fem. form.

mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु)
Wishing to make manifest or declare.
E.
वि before वृ to choose, desid. v., उ aff.

n. (-नं)
Abandoning, leaving, shunning.
E.
वि before वृज to leave, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
To be avoided, shunned, quitted, &c.
E.
वि before वृज to abandon, अनीयर् aff.

mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्)
Avoiding, leaving.
E.
वि before वृज to quit, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Left, abandoned, avoided, shunned.
E.
वि before वृज to leave, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं)
1 Low, vile.
2 Bad coloured.
3 Wanting colour.
4 Changing colour.
m. (-र्णः)
A man of a low caste, one of degrading occupation, an outcaste.
E.
वि privative, and वर्ण caste.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Pale-faced.
E.
विवर्ण colourless, वदन face.

m. (-र्त्तः)
1 Assemblage, collection, heap or multitude.
2 Dancing.
3 Going or turning round, revolving, returning.
4 Human error, worldly ignorance, the confounding of truth and falsehood, or the mistaking of unreal objects and conceiving them to be what they are not, as mirage for water, a rope for a snake, &c.
5 Modification, various or altered state or condition.
E.
वि before वृत to be, aff. क्त.

n. (-नं)
1 Going round, circumambulating an altar, &c.
2 Revolving, turning round.
3 Whirling, causing to go round.
4 Returning.
5 Passing through in succession, as various lives, various hells, &c.
5 Being, abiding.
E.
वि before वृत to be, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Turning back or round, recoiling, revolving, returning, &c.
E.
वि before वृत to be, शानच् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Revolved, returned.
2 Whirled round.
3 Turned back or away.
E.
वि before वृत to be, क्त aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Increase.
2 Cutting, dividing.
E.
वि before वृध to increase, to cut, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Increased, enlarged.
2 Cut, divided.
E.
वि before वृध to increase, to cut, क्त aff.

mfn. (-शः-शा-शं)
1 Subject, subjected.
2 Independant.
3 Apprehensive of death, unwilling though about to die.
4 Desirous of death, sedate at that period, or having the soul free from worldly cares and fears.
5 Uncontrouled, unrestrained, unsubdued.
E.
वि before वश to wish, aff. अच्.

mfn. (-सः-सा-सं)
Without clothes, naked^1.
m. (-सः)
Banishment.
E.
वि priv., and वास vesture or abode.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

mfn. (-स्त्रः-स्त्रा-स्त्रं)
Unclothed, naked.
E.
वि priv., and वस्त्र clothes.

m. (-स्वान्)
1 A god.
2 The sun.
3 ARUṆA, the charioteer of the sun.
4 The seventh or present MANU; also VAIVASVATA.
f. (-ती)
The city of the sun.
E.
वि implying variety, वस to cover or hide, affix क्विप्, विवस् here said therefore to imply various covering, as a garment of light, i. e. the rays of the sun, and मतुप् poss. aff.

mfn. (-वान्-वान्ती-वाती-वात्)
Blowing, blowing gently.
E.
वि before वा to blow, शतृ aff.

m. (-दः)
1 Contest, contention.
2 Contest at law, a legal dispute, litigation, a law suit.
E.
वि before वद to speak, aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Disputed, litigated.
E.
विवाद a law suit, अनु according to, and गत gone.

mfn. (-र्थी-र्थिनी-र्थि)
Seeking for a dispute or quarrel.
m. (-र्थी)
A litigant, a prosecutor, a plaintiff.
E.
विवाद, and अर्थिन् who seeks.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Litigated, contested at law.
E.
विवाद, and आस्पद place, भूत become, च्चि augment.

mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि)
Disputing, contending, a litigant.
E.
विवाद, and इनि aff.

n. (-णं)
Banishing, transporting.
E.
विवास, and करण making.

n. (-नं)
Exile, banishment.
E.
वि away, वासन abiding.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Banished, expelled.
E.
वि, and वस to dwell, causal v., क्त aff.

mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं)
To be expelled or transported.
E.
वि away, वस to dwell, causal v., यत् aff.

m. (-हः)
Marriage.
E.
वि mutually, वह to take, aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Married.
E.
वि before वह to bear, causal v., क्त aff.

mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं)
Marriageable, to be married.
m. (-ह्यः)
A son-in-law, a bridegroom.
E.
विवाह marriage, and यत् aff.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
1 Lonely, solitary, desart.
2 Pure, faultless.
3 Separated, distinguished, disjoined, detached.
4 Discriminative, judicious, a judge.
5 Discriminated, judged.
6 Profound, (as judgment or thought.)
7 Intent on.
E.
वि before विच to be or make separate, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
Intent upon any object.
E.
विविक्त, and भाव disposition.

mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि)
Solitary, retired, recluse, seeking or affecting solitude.
E.
विविक्त, and सेविन् who serves or pursues.

mfn. (-क्षन्-क्षती-क्षत्)
Wishing or purposing to enter.
E.
विश to enter, desid. v., शतृ Aff.

f. (-क्षा)
Wish or purpose to enter.
E.
विश to enter, desid. v., अङ् and टाप् affs.

mfn. (-क्षुः-क्षुः-क्षु)
Wishing or intending to enter.
E.
विश to enter, desid. v., उ aff.

ind.
Having considered, discussed, judged.
E.
विच to judge, with वि prefixed, and ल्यप् aff.

mfn. (-वान्-द्युषी-वस्)
Obtaining, getting.
E.
विद to know, वसु aff., with इट् inserted.

mfn. (-द्वान्-दुषी-द्वस)
Knowing, wise.
E.
विद to know, वसु aff.

mfn. (-धः-धा-धं)
Various, multiform, of many sorts.
E.
वि before विधि sort, kind.

mfn. (-वान्-श्युषी-वस्)
Entering.
E.
विश to enter, root rep., वसु aff., इट् augment.

mfn. (-श्वान्-शुषी-श्वस्)
Entering, who or what enters.
E.
विश to enter, वसु aff., root rep.

m. (-तः)
An inclosed spot of ground, abounding in grass, wood, &c., a preserved pasture, a paddock, &c.
E.
वि privative, and वीत gone.

m. (-र्त्ता)
The superintendant or owner of a preserved pasture.
E.
विवीत a paddock, &c., and भर्त्तृ a master.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
Abandoned, left.
f. (-क्ता)
A woman disliked or deserted by her husband.
E.
वि before वृच to abandon, aff. क्त.

m. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Expanded, extended, extensive, large.
2 Evident, displayed, made manifest.
3 Exposed, discovered.
4 Opened.
5 Explained, interpreted, expounded.
6 Open (as the organs of speech for the articulation of vowels and sibilants.)
f. (-ता)
A disease, an ulcer attended with much pain and heat.
E.
वि before वृ to be, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं)
Turned or twisted round, whirling, revolving, rolling.
E.
वि before वृत to be, क्त aff.

mfn. (-क्षः-क्षी-क्षं)
Large-eyed.
m. (-क्षः)
A cock.
E.
विवृत large, अक्षि the eye, and अच् aff.

f. (-तिः)
1 Explanation, exposition, gloss, comment, interpretation.
2 Making clear or manifest.
3 Discovery, exposure.
E.
वि before वृ to prefer or choose, aff. क्तिन्.

f. (-त्तिः)
Turning round, rolling, whirling, tumbling.
E.
वि before वृत to be, aff. क्तिन्.

mfn. (-सन्-सन्ती-सत्)
Wishing to be.
E.
वृत to be, desid. v., शतृ aff.

mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ)
Who or what wishes to be.
E.
वृत to be, desid. v., तृच् aff.

mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं)
Augmented, increased.
E.
वि, and वृद्ध the same.

f. (-द्धिः)
Growth, increase, augmentation.
E.
वि before वृद्धि the same.

m. (-कः)
1 Discrimination, judgment, the faculty of distinguishing things by their properties, and classing them according to their real not apparent nature; in the Vedānta system, it is applied to the power of separating Brahma or invisible spirit, from the ostensible world, truth from untruth, or reality from illusion.
2 Discussion, investigation.
3 A reservoir, a bath.
E.
वि severally, विच to judge, aff. घञ्.

f. (-ता)
Judgment, discrimination, the faculty or property of judgment.
E.
तल् added to the last; also with त्व, विवेकत्वं.

n. (-त्वं)
Discrimination, discernment.
E.
विवेकदृश्वन्, and त्व aff.; or with तल्, विवेकदृश्वता.

m. (-श्वा)
A wise or discerning man.
E.
विवेक, and दृश्वन् who sees.

f. (-ता)
Discussion, discrimination, discriminativeness.
E.
विवेकी discriminative, and तल् aff.; also विवेकित्व n. (-त्वं)

mfn. (-की-किनी-कि)
Judicious, discriminative.
m. (-की)
A sage, a philosopher, a judge.
E.
वि before विच to judge, घिनुण् aff.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
To be discussed or judged.
E.
वि before विच to judge, तव्य aff.; also विवेच्य and विवेचनीय.

n. (-नं)
Discrimination, judgment, distinguishing truth from falsehood.
E.
वि before विच to judge, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
To be judged or discussed.
E.
वि, विच् to judge, अनीयर् aff.

m. (-ढा)
A husband, a bridegroom, a lover.
E.
वि before वह to obtain, aff. तृन्.

mfn. (-वन्-वती-वत्)
Silent, refraining from or refusing to speak.
E.
वि privative वुवत् speaking.

m. (-कः)
Affectation of indifference, one of the branches of amorous dalliance, or feminine actions, tending to excite love or desire.
E.
वि before वा to go, aff. कु, विवु said here to mean a particular gait, and ओक house, place, site.
